items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Once we did a thing, it was Bob Thiele, who was with a record company... [INTERVIEWEE] Was it Atlantic?

ctx.x: Yeah, we’ve gotten pressure. Although we haven’t succumbed to it often, but once we had to.
Once we did a thing, it was Bob Thiele, who was with a record company, I don’t remember.
Was it Atlantic? © Fillius Jazz Archive -33-
